abstract: A system of fail-soft (emergency) measures for a production-oriented MT system is discussed, stating first the specific purposes of such a system, and showing then, how these measures are being used in the system of English-to-Czech machine translation as prepared by the group of mathematical linguistics at Charles University in Prague.
